title: Entities
doc: Every character, creature, vehicle and turret class: mesh, physics, weapons, AI, sounds and animations.
notes: The loader looks for the next $Name: (case-sensitive raw text search) before each entry, so text between entries is skipped; at most 75 classes in the stock game.

sections.name: #Entity Classes
sections.doc: All entity classes; each entry starts at $Name:, and #End (optional) ends the list.

fields.name: $Name:
fields.doc: Unique entity class name used by levels and other tables.

fields.name: $V3D Filename:
fields.doc: Character or vehicle mesh (.v3d becomes .v3c/.v3m).

fields.name: $Debris Filename:
fields.doc: Mesh broken into debris when the entity explodes.

fields.name: $LOD Distances:
fields.doc: Level of detail switch distances in braces separated by white space, e.g. { 6 9 }; at most 4 values.

fields.name: $Corpse V3D Filename:
fields.doc: Mesh used for the corpse.

fields.name: $Corpse Emitter:
fields.doc: Particle emitter attached to the corpse.

fields.name: $Movemode:
fields.doc: Movement mode name from movemodes.tbl.

fields.name: $Mass:
fields.doc: Mass.

fields.name: $Material:
fields.doc: Material name (materials.tbl) used for impacts and footsteps.

fields.name: $Flags:
fields.doc: Entity behaviour flags; an unknown flag name stops the game.

fields.name: $Flags2:
fields.doc: More entity flags.

fields.name: $Collision Radius:
fields.doc: Collision radius.

fields.name: $Collision Damage Given:
fields.doc: Damage dealt when colliding with something.

fields.name: $Movement Radius:
fields.doc: Radius used for movement collision.

fields.name: $FOV:
fields.doc: Field of view of the entity's eyes.

fields.name: $Envirosuit:
fields.doc: Armour (envirosuit) points.

fields.name: $Life:
fields.doc: Hit points.

fields.name: $Damage Type Factor:
fields.doc: Damage multiplier for one damage type: type name, then factor.

fields.name: $Min Relative Eye PHB:

children.name: $Max Relative Eye PHB:
children.doc: Upper limit of eye pitch, heading, bank; required after the minimum.

fields.doc: Lower limit of eye pitch, heading, bank relative to the body.

fields.name: $Max Vel:
fields.doc: Top speed.

fields.name: +slow factor:
fields.doc: Speed factor when moving slowly.

fields.name: +fast factor:
fields.doc: Speed factor when moving fast.

fields.name: $Acceleration:
fields.doc: Acceleration.

fields.name: $Max Rot Vel:
fields.doc: Top turning speed.

fields.name: $Rot Acceleration:
fields.doc: Turning acceleration.

fields.name: $Allowed Weapons:
fields.doc: Weapons this entity may use; ("") or () for none; at most 64.

fields.name: $Default Primary:
fields.doc: Weapon the entity starts with; may be "".

fields.name: $Default Secondary:
fields.doc: Secondary weapon the entity starts with; may be "".

fields.name: $Force Launch Sound:
fields.doc: Foley played instead of the weapon's own launch sound.

fields.name: $Default Melee:
fields.doc: Melee weapon.

fields.name: $Primary Muzzle Glare Name:
fields.doc: Glare shown at the primary muzzle.

fields.name: $Primary Warmup FX:
fields.doc: Effect played while the primary weapon warms up.

fields.name: $Thruster VFX #:
fields.doc: Thruster effect for prop point number #, numbered from 1 without gaps ("$Thruster VFX 1:", "$Thruster VFX 2:", ...).

fields.name: $Corona (Glare) #:

parts.doc: tag; "headlamp" makes it the head lamp

fields.doc: Glare for corona prop point number #, numbered from 1 without gaps: glare name, then "headlamp" or another tag.

fields.name: $Helmet V3D Filename:
fields.doc: Helmet mesh.

fields.name: $Unholster Delay:
fields.doc: Seconds before a drawn weapon can fire.

fields.name: $Attack Style:
fields.doc: AI attack behaviour.

fields.name: $Blind Pursuit Time:
fields.doc: Seconds the AI keeps chasing a target it cannot see.

fields.name: $Persona:
fields.doc: Voice persona (personas.tbl).

fields.name: $FlySnd:

parts.doc: sound file name; "" means none (then nothing else follows)
minimum distance in metres (only when a file is given)
volume scale (only when a file is given)

fields.doc: Looping flight sound: file, minimum distance, volume; "" for none.

fields.name: $Min FlySnd Volume:
fields.doc: Lowest volume of the flight sound.

fields.name: $Move Sound:
fields.doc: Foley while moving.

fields.name: $Engine Rev Fwd Sound:
fields.doc: Foley when the engine revs forward.

fields.name: $Engine Rev Back Sound:
fields.doc: Foley when the engine revs backward.

fields.name: $StartleSnd:
fields.doc: Foley when startled.

fields.name: $AttachSnd:
fields.doc: Foley when attaching.

fields.name: $DetachSnd:
fields.doc: Foley when detaching.

fields.name: $RotateSnd:
fields.doc: Foley while rotating.

fields.name: $Footstep Sound:
fields.doc: Footstep foley; one line per material set.

fields.name: $Climb Footstep Sounds:
fields.doc: Climbing footstep foley; one line per material set.

fields.name: $Crawl Footstep Sound:
fields.doc: Crawling footstep foley.

fields.name: $LandSnd:
fields.doc: Landing foley; one line per material set.

fields.name: $Impact Death Sound:
fields.doc: Foley for a death by impact.

fields.name: $JumpSnd:
fields.doc: Foley when jumping.

fields.name: $HeadLamp On Sound:
fields.doc: Foley when the head lamp turns on.

fields.name: $HeadLamp Off Sound:
fields.doc: Foley when the head lamp turns off.

fields.name: $Low_Pain Sounds:
fields.doc: Foley for light pain.

fields.name: $Med_Pain Sounds:
fields.doc: Foley for medium pain.

fields.name: $Squash Sounds:
fields.doc: Foley when squashed.

fields.name: $DeathSnd:
fields.doc: Foley on death.

fields.name: $Explode Anim:

children.name: $Explode Offset:
children.doc: Offset of the explosion from the entity.

fields.doc: Vclip played when the entity explodes.

fields.name: $emitter:
fields.doc: Particle emitter attached to the entity.

fields.name: +State:

children.name: +Footstep Trigger:
children.doc: Animation frame range that plays footsteps: two numbers.

fields.doc: Looping animation: state name, then animation file; footstep triggers may follow.

fields.name: +Action:
fields.doc: One-shot animation: action name, animation file, foley played with it.

fields.name: +Weapon Specific:

children.name: +Spine Adjustment:
children.doc: Spine bend while holding this weapon.

children.name: +State:
+Footstep Trigger:
children.doc: Animation frame range that plays footsteps: two numbers.
Looping animation: state name, then animation file; footstep triggers may follow.

children.name: +Action:
children.doc: One-shot animation: action name, animation file, foley played with it.

fields.doc: Animations used while holding one weapon: weapon name, then its +State and +Action lines.

fields.name: $Use:

children.name: +radius:
children.doc: Distance from which the entity can be used; required after a known $Use value.

fields.doc: What happens when the player uses this entity; "none" or other text means not usable and then +radius is left out.

fields.name: $Collision Sphere:

children.name: +spring length:
children.doc: Spring rest length; required after +spring constant.

fields.doc: Extra collision sphere: prop point name, then two numbers.

fields.name: $Num Skins:

children.name: $Skin:
children.doc: Alternate skin: skin name, then the replacement textures in order (at most 12); exactly $Num Skins lines.

fields.doc: Number of $Skin: lines that follow.

fields.name: $Cockpit VFX:
fields.doc: Cockpit effect seen from inside the vehicle.

fields.name: $Body Temperature(F):
fields.doc: Body temperature for the rail driver heat scanner.
